canonical_owner: SKILL.md: Evidence Enforcement Mode and Self-Application

acceptance_criteria.condition: Schema version 2 requires all normative quality decisions and execution-bound evidence for every passed verification.
Behavioral and high-risk configuration changes cannot bypass the evidence gate through schema v1, weak revisions, self-review labels, or non-executable evidence.
Historical schema v1 evidence remains individually valid while the frozen V8 preregistration and its archived inputs reject live protocol drift.
The Skill package, Python sources, workflow YAML, and deterministic causal fixtures pass their respective validators.
The repair does not claim aggregate Skill-effect uplift because V8 has no completed paired observations.

invariants: A passed changed-evidence check is bound to the same successful command, exit code, UTC execution time, and existing repository revision.
Schema v1 historical records are not rewritten or silently rebound to current bytes.
A high-risk behavioral change requires valid schema version 2 level 2 evidence.
The V8 experiment remains planned and cannot use live Skill bytes or mutable collection inputs as frozen protocol evidence.
replaced_paths: scripts/validate_evidence.py: unverifiable schema-v2 execution and review acceptance paths
tests/test_effect_runner_v8.py: live-runtime and mutable-input V8 collection paths

safeguards.name: schema-v2 complete quality decisions
safeguards.rationale: The validator requires all 15 normative decisions with applied or not_applicable rationales.

safeguards.name: hash-linked execution evidence
safeguards.rationale: Passed checks require a hash-verified command_output or test_output bound to the same command with exit code zero, UTC timestamp, and an existing revision.

safeguards.name: high-risk and secret path gate
safeguards.rationale: Environment, secret, authentication, payment, schema, and other high-risk behavior paths are classified conservatively and require Level 2 evidence when enabled.

safeguards.name: independent review evidence
safeguards.rationale: Level 2 records reject obvious self-review identities and require a hash-linked review_report.

safeguards.name: frozen V8 protocol inputs
safeguards.rationale: The V8 runner validates the committed preregistration and archived runtime separately from the live Skill worktree.

design_boundary.rationale: SKILL.md defines the evidence contract; validate_evidence.py owns artifact semantics; check_change_evidence.py owns changed-file enforcement.

dependency_audit.rationale: No runtime dependency or import edge was added; validators continue to use the Python standard library and repository tooling.

extension_decision.rationale: This repair tightens existing validation boundaries and adds no extension point or adapter contract.

data_ownership.rationale: The package records evidence metadata and hashes only; it does not own mutable business or personal data.

error_model.rationale: Invalid evidence produces stable validator errors, while unknown causal or experiment outcomes remain explicitly unknown rather than passing.

contract_evolution.rationale: Schema v1 remains readable for historical artifacts, while new behavioral work must use the stricter schema v2 contract covered by regression tests.

operational_budget.rationale: V8 timeout and frozen-input constraints are validated before collection, and the Skill effect analyzer refuses incomplete or unrun trials.

threat_boundary.rationale: Secret and configuration paths are treated as behavioral or high-risk so they cannot evade review through file naming or extension tricks.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The Skill, validators, tests, templates, workflow, historical evidence refresh, and this evidence artifact are delivered as one reviewable commit.

release_recovery.rationale: The repair is reversible by reverting one atomic commit; V8 collection remains blocked until its frozen protocol is explicitly run and analyzed.

data_migration.rationale: No application or persisted business data schema is changed.

configuration_secrets.rationale: The changed-file classifier explicitly covers .env variants and secret/configuration behavior, with no secret values copied into evidence.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No package, lockfile, external action, or third-party dependency is added or updated.

operational_knowledge.rationale: SKILL.md, README, enforcement references, tests, and the review artifact document the new evidence and V8 boundaries for future maintainers.

reproducibility.rationale: The exact commands, UTC execution timestamp, repository revision, hashes, Python checks, YAML parse, and planned V8 analyzer result are recorded.

remaining_risks: Reviewer independence is enforced heuristically by label and cannot prove organizational independence.
Evidence hashes prove artifact identity, not the truthfulness of a written summary.
V8 remains a prepared and validated protocol with no paired trials, so no aggregate Skill-effect uplift is supported.
The changed-file classifier is conservative and may require explicit not_applicable evidence for future non-runtime artifacts.

causal.symptom: The pre-repair enforcement surface could accept unverifiable changed evidence and the V8 collection surface could be exposed to mutable runtime or input drift.
causal.discriminating_check: Adversarial tests exercise schema-v1 bypasses, incomplete quality decisions, self-review labels, invalid revisions, same-command binding, environment and secret paths, symbolic links, stale commits, post-preflight source replacement, live reload, and V8 timeout/version drift.
causal.upstream_path: changed files -> evidence classifier -> evidence validator -> review and execution artifact binding; V8 CLI inputs -> frozen preregistration and archive -> staged runtime -> paired execution and analysis
causal.timeline_evidence: The repair follows the frozen V8 commit 3c838583 and refreshes historical evidence hashes without rewriting their original Git-bound provenance.
